DONE / IN MOTION — and you were right to flag this, Sam. Catching a live Terra Lotus crossed wire before we send $78,580.

WHAT I DID: Dispatched the CRM Developer to create a HIGH-priority task assigned to Aidan on the Terra Lotus account — 'report all direct communications; reconcile before PLL sends contract.' It asks Aidan for exactly what he's sent or discussed with Terra Lotus, the channel, any quote/pricing/contract version he gave, and the confirmed contact name + billing/shipping address — so PLL sends ONE correct contract, not a duplicate.

THE CROSSED WIRE I FOUND: Our contract records show the Terra Lotus Manufacturing Agreement as UNSENT since Aug 2, still carrying a placeholder contact name/address. But the CRM shows task #298 'deliver quote + contract' closed DONE with a WhatsApp delivery logged Aug 5 (note #11). Both can't be fully true — something already reached Terra Lotus via WhatsApp on Aug 5. I need to know from Aidan what it was before we send the formal package, or we risk double-sending or contradicting a price already quoted.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU (one thing): to pull a live update straight from Aidan I need either his CRM session restored so I can DM him in Team Chat, or his email address. The task is assigned to him either way — a direct pull is just faster. Which do you want?

Bottom line: the task is created and pointed at Aidan, and the real win is we caught a possible double-send on the biggest deal on the board before it happened.

To pull that update straight from Aidan, I need either his CRM login restored so I can message him, or his email. Which one do you want me to use?
